instructions.name: accept_authority
docs: Accepts authority from a pending authority

instructions.name: accept_program_authority
docs: Completes the program-authority handshake. Only the pending authority may call this,
promoting itself to the program authority.
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the pending program authority

instructions.name: add_permission
docs: Adds a new permission entry for a wallet on a vault
Creates a PDA account storing permission flags (can_pause, can_update_exchange_rate,
strategist_group) for the given wallet, scoped to the vault.
* `wallet` - The public key to grant permissions to
* `can_pause` - Whether this wallet can pause the vault
* `can_update_exchange_rate` - Whether this wallet can update the exchange rate
* `strategist_group` - Bitmask for strategist action grouping (0 = no strategist permission)
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority

instructions.name: claim_performance_fees_in_base
docs: Claims accumulated performance fees in base asset, transferring them to the performance payout
* `BoringErrorCode::InvalidTokenProgram` - If token program doesn't match mint

instructions.name: claim_platform_fees_in_base
docs: Claims accumulated platform fees in base asset, transferring them to the platform payout
* `BoringErrorCode::InvalidTokenProgram` - If token program doesn't match mint

instructions.name: close_compliance_approval
docs: Permissionlessly closes an expired ComplianceApproval PDA, returning its
rent to the user the approval belongs to.
* `vault` - The vault state pubkey the approval was issued for (PDA seed)
* `expiration` - The expiration timestamp of the approval (PDA seed)
* `BoringErrorCode::ComplianceApprovalNotExpired` - If the approval has not yet reached its expiration timestamp

accounts.name: signer
docs: Anyone may crank the close of an expired approval.

instructions.name: close_cpi_digest
docs: Closes a CPI digest account, returning its rent to the signer.
NOTE: Its on the caller to remove the deposit/withdraw_cpi_digest on any AssetData.
* `digest` - The 32-byte digest identifying the CPI digest PDA (PDA seed)
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority and does not hold the can_pause permission

accounts.name: permission
docs: Required, only when the signer is not the vault authority, to prove the signer holds the

instructions.name: configure_exchange_rate_update_bounds
docs: Configures the exchange rate update bounds
* `upper_bound` - Maximum allowed increase in exchange rate (in bps)
* `lower_bound` - Maximum allowed decrease in exchange rate (in bps)
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority

instructions.name: deploy
docs: * `authority` - The vault authority who can manage vault settings
* `base_asset` - The base asset mint address for the vault
* `exchange_rate` - Initial exchange rate between base asset and shares
* `strategist` - Address of the strategist who can execute vault strategies
* `payout_address` - Address where fees will be sent
* `decimals` - Decimals for the share token mint
* `allowed_exchange_rate_change_upper_bound` - Maximum allowed increase in exchange rate (in bps)
* `allowed_exchange_rate_change_lower_bound` - Maximum allowed decrease in exchange rate (in bps)
* `minimum_update_delay_in_seconds` - Minimum time between exchange rate updates
* `BoringErrorCode::InvalidPayoutAddress` - If payout address is zero address

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: The mint of the share token.

accounts.name: transfer_hook_program
docs: share mint is created with the transfer hook extension enabled for every
deployment (compliance and non-compliance), so share locking is always available.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: * `min_mint_amount` - Minimum amount of shares to mint
* `BoringErrorCode::InvalidTokenProgram` - If token program doesn't match mint

accounts.name: allowed_user
docs: The depositor's AllowedUser PDA. Always required and initialized on first deposit, even
when compliance mode is off and no share lock is active. That way a share lock enabled
after the deposit can never block the depositor's transfers for lack of this account.

accounts.name: target_program_data
docs: Required only when the deposit cpi digest is bound to the target program's deployed code.

instructions.name: deposit_sol
docs: * `min_mint_amount` - Minimum amount of shares to mint
* `BoringErrorCode::SlippageExceeded` - If min share amount is not met

accounts.name: allowed_user
docs: The depositor's AllowedUser PDA. Always required and initialized on first deposit, even
when compliance mode is off and no share lock is active. That way a share lock enabled
after the deposit can never block the depositor's transfers for lack of this account.

accounts.name: target_program_data
docs: Required only when the deposit cpi digest is bound to the target program's deployed code.

instructions.name: enable_allowed_user
docs: Creates and enables an `AllowedUser` for an arbitrary address, callable only
by the compliance authority. Intended for participants that cannot make a
compliant deposit themselves — notably the Boring Queue PDA.
* `user` - The address to enable as an allowed user
* `BoringErrorCode::InvalidComplianceAuthority` - If signer is not the compliance authority

accounts.name: payer
docs: Separated from `compliance_authority` so the authority never needs to carry a SOL balance

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Initializes the program config with the given authority
* `authority` - The pubkey of the authority who can deploy vaults

instructions.name: initialize_cpi_digest
docs: Initializes the CPI digest for managing vault assets
Note: This function does not check that the provided digest
actually corresponds to the given operators and expected size
but in the case that it doesn't this digest is just unusable.

instructions.name: manage
docs: Executes a management operation on the vault
* `args` - Management arguments including CPI call details

accounts.name: target_program_data
docs: Required only when the cpi digest is bound to the target program's deployed code.

instructions.name: pause_accounting
docs: Pauses accounting (rate updates, vesting, safe rate reads, manage, fees, share mint/burn).
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority and does not have can_pause permission

instructions.name: pause_all
docs: Convenience: pauses all three flags (teller, accounting, manage) in one instruction.
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority and does not have can_pause permission

instructions.name: pause_manage
docs: Pauses the `manage` instruction only (strategy execution); everything else keeps running.
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority and does not have can_pause permission

instructions.name: pause_teller
docs: Pauses the teller, preventing deposits and withdrawals (accounting keeps running).
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority and does not have can_pause permission

instructions.name: post_loss
docs: Posts a loss to the vault, reducing the exchange rate
* `loss_amount` - The amount of loss to post
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the exchange rate provider

instructions.name: remove_cpi_digest_from_asset
docs: Removes (clears to the default pubkey) an asset's deposit and/or withdraw CPI digest.
* `remove_deposit` - When true, resets `asset_data.deposit_cpi_digest` to the default pubkey
* `remove_withdraw` - When true, resets `asset_data.withdraw_cpi_digest` to the default pubkey
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority and does not hold the can_pause permission

accounts.name: permission
docs: Required, only when the signer is not the vault authority, to prove the signer holds the

instructions.name: remove_permission
docs: Removes an existing permission entry for a wallet on a vault
Closes the permission PDA account and returns the rent to the payer.
* `wallet` - The public key whose permissions are being revoked
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority

instructions.name: reset_high_water_mark
docs: Collects any fees owed up to now at the unchanged rate, then re-anchors the
high water mark to the current exchange rate.
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority

instructions.name: revoke_user_compliance
docs: Revokes user compliance by setting AllowedUsed.enabled = false.
* `BoringErrorCode::InvalidComplianceAuthority` - If signer is not the compliance authority

accounts.name: payer
docs: Separated from `compliance_authority` so the authority never needs to carry a SOL balance

instructions.name: set_compliance
docs: Enables compliance mode on the vault and sets the compliance authority
Once enabled, compliance mode cannot be disabled. The compliance authority
is responsible for managing the allowlist of permitted users.
This instruction is idempotent and used to change the compliance_authority.
* `compliance_authority` - The pubkey of the authority who can manage user compliance
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority
* `BoringErrorCode::InvalidComplianceAuthority` - If compliance authority is the zero address

instructions.name: set_deposit_cap
docs: Sets the deposit cap (maximum total share supply reachable via deposits).
* `cap` - Maximum total share supply; `u64::MAX` disables the cap
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority

instructions.name: set_deposit_cpi_digest
docs: Sets the allowed CPI digest for deposits
* `cpi_digest` - The allowed CPI digest pubkey (Pubkey::default() to clear)
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority
* `BoringErrorCode::InvalidCpiDigest` - If the digest account is missing, does not match
* `BoringErrorCode::CpiAmountNotBound` - If the digest does not bind its CPI amount

accounts.name: cpi_digest
docs: The digest being attached Required unless the `cpi_digest` argument is the default pubkey.

instructions.name: set_deposit_sub_account
docs: Sets the deposit sub-account for the vault
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority

instructions.name: set_deviation_bounds
docs: Sets the maximum deviation bounds for yield and loss
* `max_deviation_yield_bps` - Maximum allowed daily yield deviation in basis points
* `max_deviation_loss_bps` - Maximum allowed loss before auto-pause in basis points
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority

instructions.name: set_fees
docs: Sets the platform and performance fees for the vault
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority

instructions.name: set_lock_duration
docs: Sets the vault's share-lock duration and syncs it into the transfer hook's
HookConfig. This is the only path that may change the hook's `lock_duration_seconds`.
* `lock_duration_seconds` - New share-lock duration (`0` disables the lock)
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority
* `HookErrorCode::InvalidLockDuration` - If the duration is negative or exceeds the max

instructions.name: set_payout
docs: Sets the payout address for the given fee type (platform or performance).
* `fee_type` - Which fee recipient to update (platform or performance)
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority
* `BoringErrorCode::InvalidPayoutAddress` - If payout address is zero address

instructions.name: set_withdraw_authority
docs: Sets the withdraw authority for the vault
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority

instructions.name: set_withdraw_cpi_digest
docs: Sets the allowed CPI digest for withdrawals
* `cpi_digest` - The allowed CPI digest pubkey (Pubkey::default() to clear)
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority
* `BoringErrorCode::InvalidCpiDigest` - If the digest account is missing, does not match
* `BoringErrorCode::CpiAmountNotBound` - If the digest does not bind its CPI amount

accounts.name: cpi_digest
docs: The digest being attached Required unless the `cpi_digest` argument is the default pubkey.

instructions.name: set_withdraw_sub_account
docs: Sets the withdraw sub-account for the vault
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority

instructions.name: transfer_authority
docs: Stages a new vault authority. The transfer only takes effect once
* `pending_authority` - The new pending authority or the default pubkey

instructions.name: transfer_program_authority
docs: Stages a new program-level authority. Only the current program authority may call this.
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the current program authority

instructions.name: unpause_accounting
docs: Unpauses accounting, re-enabling rate updates, vesting, safe rate reads, manage, fees, and
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority

instructions.name: unpause_all
docs: Convenience: unpauses all three flags (teller, accounting, manage) in one instruction.
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority

instructions.name: unpause_manage
docs: Unpauses the `manage` instruction, re-enabling strategy execution.
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority

instructions.name: unpause_teller
docs: Unpauses the teller, allowing deposits and withdrawals.
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority

instructions.name: update_asset_data
docs: Updates the asset data configuration for a given asset
* `args` - The asset data update arguments including:
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority
* `BoringErrorCode::InvalidPriceFeed` - If price feed is invalid for non-pegged asset

accounts.name: asset
docs: would only prevent deposits with that asset, which is not a security risk since the asset mint

instructions.name: update_cpi_digest_strategist_group
docs: Updates the strategist group mask for an existing CPI digest.
Only the vault authority may call this instruction.

instructions.name: update_exchange_rate
docs: Updates the exchange rate for the vault
`new_exchange_rate` is the **gross** rate: total vault assets / shares, including assets
still earmarked for unclaimed platform and performance fees. The program accrues the fees
owed for the elapsed interval and then stores the rate net of the full outstanding fee
liability, so the caller must not pre-deduct fees from the reported rate.

instructions.name: update_maximum_vest_duration
docs: Updates the vault's maximum `vest_yield` streaming duration in seconds.
* `new_maximum_vest_duration` - New maximum vesting duration in seconds
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority
* `BoringErrorCode::InvalidVestDuration` - If less than the minimum vest duration

instructions.name: update_minimum_vest_duration
docs: Updates the vault's minimum `vest_yield` streaming duration in seconds.
* `new_minimum_vest_duration` - New minimum vesting duration in seconds
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority
* `BoringErrorCode::InvalidVestDuration` - If zero or greater than the maximum vest duration

instructions.name: update_permission
docs: Updates the permission flags for an existing wallet on a vault
Modifies the can_pause, can_update_exchange_rate, and strategist_group
fields on an already-initialized permission PDA account.
* `wallet` - The public key whose permissions are being updated
* `can_pause` - New value for whether this wallet can pause the vault
* `can_update_exchange_rate` - New value for whether this wallet can update the exchange rate
* `strategist_group` - New bitmask for strategist action grouping (0 = no strategist permission)
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority

instructions.name: update_vault_accrue_mode
docs: When switching from `VestingYield` to `ExchangeRateStep`, the vesting state
is reset to default values (clearing the TWAS accumulator and all vesting fields).
* `new_mode` - The new accrual mode to set
* `BoringErrorCode::NotAuthorized` - If signer is not the vault authority

instructions.name: vest_to_exchange_rate
docs: Flushes pending vested yield into the exchange rate and collects fees,
without posting any new yield. VestingYield accrual mode only.
Restricted to signers holding the `can_update_exchange_rate` permission
* `BoringErrorCode::InvalidAccrualMode` - If vault is not in VestingYield mode

instructions.name: vest_yield
docs: Vests accumulated yield in VestingYield accrual mode
Updates the exchange rate based on the time-weighted vesting schedule.

instructions.name: view_cpi_digest
docs: Views the CPI digest for a management operation
* `args` - Management arguments to generate digest for

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: * `min_asset_amount` - Minimum amount of assets to receive
* `BoringErrorCode::InvalidTokenProgram` - If token program doesn't match mint

types.name: ComplianceApproval
docs: PDA account that records a consumed compliance approval, enforcing single use

Validated against Permission.strategist_group via bitwise AND.

than the default pubkey, every CPI must pass this ProgramData account and it must
still be at `deployment_slot`, so any upgrade invalidates the digest.

docs: The deployment slot approved for `program_data`. Ignored when unbound.

fields.name: accrual_mode

fields.name: performance_fees_owed_in_base_asset

fields.name: last_strategist_update_timestamp

fields.name: state_last_update_timestamp

fields.name: maximum_vest_duration

fields.name: performance_fee_remainder

vesting, safe rate reads, claim fees, and share mint/burn.

fields.name: lock_duration_seconds

lock_duration_seconds field on the transfer HookConfig

fields.name: last_virtual_share_price

Gains are added here per-share as they vest; the human-readable
exchange_rate (= lastSharePrice in EVM) is derived as

fields.name: last_vesting_update

fields.name: start_vesting_time
docs: The start time for the yield streaming period

fields.name: end_vesting_time
docs: The end time for the yield streaming period

fields.name: cumulative_supply
docs: Accumulated supply * time for TWAS calculation

fields.name: vesting_period_start
docs: Start of the current TWAS window, reset by vest_yield
